profile.name: Meraj Hossain
profile.title: Graphics Designer | Video Editor | Motion Graphics Designer
profile.subtitle: Visual Storyteller & Motion Designer
profile.headline: I craft compelling visual storytelling across motion graphics, video editing, and brand design

aboutText.intro: Creative Graphics Designer and Motion Graphics Artist with proven experience in branding, social media design, video editing, and promotional content.
aboutText.background: Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite and passionate about visual storytelling, creative problem solving, and delivering high-quality designs for digital and print media.
aboutText.philosophy: Every frame matters. I strip away the superfluous and elevate visual rhythm, kinetic motion, and color harmony to make stories felt, not just seen.

description: Design promotional materials for marketing campaigns.
Create social media creatives and print designs.
Create and upload motion graphics templates.
Design stock assets for global clients.
Assisted in technical and administrative tasks.

values.title: Craft & Precision
values.description: Deep mastery of keyframing, typography pacing, and color grading. Every cut, transition, and pixel is tuned to create lasting impact.

values.title: Visual Storytelling
values.description: Motion design exists to tell an unmistakable story. Bringing ideas and brands to life through dynamic energy and emotion.

values.title: Continuous Evolution
values.description: Pushing boundaries with cutting-edge motion trends, visual effects, and modern digital art aesthetics.

process.title: Observe & Concept
process.description: Deep understanding of the brief, audience context, and core narrative before touching the timeline.

process.title: Storyboard & Styleframe
process.description: Designing visual styleframes, motion boards, and color palettes for seamless client alignment.

process.title: Motion & Animation
process.description: Breathing life into vector assets with fluid easing curves, 3D layer depth, and kinetic rhythm in After Effects.

process.title: Color Grade & Sound Sync
process.description: Fine-tuning exposure, cinematic LUTs, and syncing beats to deliver broadcast-level punch.

process.title: Delivery & Multi-Format
process.description: Exporting pristine high-res deliverables optimized for social feeds, digital billboards, and broadcast.
